method: Fresh isolated TypeScript compilation, guarded exact HEOS R32, frozen copies of drive/inverter-demand test files; 0.25 s native owner trajectory. Source/backend files unchanged over final run.

testCases.name: startup bounds demand, preserves actuator state across branch demand changes, and waits after Off
safety overrides minimum speed, pickup arming and startup hold until pressure and dwell recover
ratio thresholds stay strictly ordered for all supported positive lifts
temperature protection cannot recover from an unavailable discharge prediction
Reference inverter starts at its admitted minimum and immediately follows bounded up/down slew
calling branches retain a dimensionless normalized UA reserve when sensible demand crosses zero
room demand balances target load and applies directional antiwindup independently
exact published owner house maintains native continuous inverter service for 1200 seconds
native cold startup and retained-hot-coil restart use admitted speed and actual energy ramp
Reference slew configuration rejects nonfinite/nonpositive rates before state mutation
inverter modulates continuously near target when load exceeds minimum capacity
below-minimum load cycles with dwell, while conventional operation uses a fixed speed
controller history rolls back on native failure and clears on strategy change
live minimum-speed edits cannot publish a running command outside the selected range

scope: Generic/native/defaultEngineConfig minimum18 retained. Exact owner native fixture explicitly selects qualified interactive Reference8 without changing published house inputs.
Ordinary Reference inverter receives explicit2rps/s up and4rps/s down slew; first speed equals admitted minimum. Inventory/fixed/defrost retain legacy drive policy.
Unclamped capacity-to-speed request is retained and directional lower/upper antiwindup uses actual actuator authority. Accepted transaction rollback remains unchanged.
Peer/root cyclebc2071f3 corrects a physical-cooling pressure search bound and flow seed without altering actual conservation/pinch/pipe/envelope checks.
limitations: Unequal multi-branch physical cooling low-speed remains unsupported; root runtime explicitly retains declared18rps there and in inventory.
No OEM speed map or measured-watt calibration is claimed. These tests assert physical service, admitted slew and actual energy, not500W/200W/130W values.
Combined regression, runtime/UI mapping, browser validation and deployment are separate root gates.
